en: Black-and-white postcard showing a rural European village landscape taken from an elevated viewpoint. In the foreground are two substantial farm or manor houses with steep gabled tile roofs and multi-pane windows, separated by a road and surrounded by trees and gardens. Beyond them stretch cultivated fields, orchards, and scattered tree lines, with gently rolling hills on the horizon. In the mid-distance a small church with a steeple and other farm buildings are visible, as well as another church-like building on a low rise.
